unlisted_practices: Passive language-based digital biomarker from routine phone calls analyzed with LLMs to detect prodromal and progressive changes in iRBD/Parkinson's disease
Sample size estimation for a neuroprotective trial using the LLM-derived biomarker

screen.reason: The study evaluates an LLM-based biomarker using naturalistic speech data from real-world phone calls over 2 years, testing its ability to detect prodromal Parkinson's disease progression, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
